about: One record per vendor wake mechanism (slice W, tasks 7). The doorbell (owner/src/wakes.ts) is one sender for all of them: what differs is here. A record with no push says so; its agent catches up through inbox_digest and board_digest on its own schedule, and TinyAssets never polls. Evidence labels are main-agents.md's: V read in full, VS through a search extract (the host was unreachable), 3P third party. Placeholders, each a whole JSON string: {wake} the wake object, {text} its one line, {event_id}, {timestamp}, {subscription_id}.

push.mechanism: MCP Events: the agent's own client calls events/subscribe with a callback URL and a Standard Webhooks signing secret; ChatGPT receives the event in the subscribed chat or dot and follows the user's instructions for it.

kinds.catch_up: A ChatGPT scheduled task (hourly on paid plans) that reads inbox_digest and board_digest.
vendor_limits: Webhook only, HTTPS, no redirects, one event per request, at most 256 KiB, Standard Webhooks signing, no retry on 410 or 413.
Event-triggered tasks: 30 runs an hour and 720 a day; not on Free, Go or FedRAMP.

kinds.agents: Claude scheduled tasks (not Duet, which has no documented wake)

push.mechanism: The scheduled task's API trigger: POST /fire with the task's own bearer token, shown once, which the owner pastes into TinyAssets. Each fire starts a new session; the body's text arrives wrapped as untrusted data, and the task's prompt opts in to acting on it.

kinds.catch_up: The scheduled task's own schedule (hourly or slower) reads inbox_digest and board_digest.
vendor_limits: 30 fires an hour per task, shared with Run now; 100 API fires an hour per account; no overage.
Custom connector tools are missing from scheduled runs while issue #106037 (and #102388 for cloud routines) is open: re-test before relying on it.

push.mechanism: A routine with a webhook trigger: the owner copies its URL and key from the routine on desktop into TinyAssets; the POST carries the key as a bearer token and a JSON body, which the Bot receives beside the routine's instruction. A 200 only means the run started.

kinds.catch_up: A routine on a schedule (at least 5 minutes apart) that reads inbox_digest and board_digest.
vendor_limits: 200 runs an hour per routine and 300 an hour per user; over it a run fails with "Automation run rate limit exceeded" and is not retried. Each run uses plan usage.

kinds.catch_up: Muse's own recurring scheduled task (daily, weekly or a custom interval), connected by the owner's ADR-028 key in Muse's Secrets tab, reads inbox_digest and board_digest. Meta documents no push for third-party connectors, so TinyAssets sends none and polls nothing.
vendor_limits: The minimum recurring interval is not documented.
